papers.title: Corporate Earnings Calls and Analyst Beliefs
papers.summary: Text-morphing LLM methodology to measure analyst reaction to earnings call narratives. Key finding: analysts OVER-react to sentiment/optimism but UNDER-react to risk/uncertainty narratives. Suggests asymmetric narrative weighting in PEAD signal construction.
papers.relevance_reason: H163/H168 theoretical foundation: identifies analyst belief formation bias exploitable for PEAD. Suggests H168 should differentially weight uncertainty language (risk/hedging words) beyond pure positive-negative polarity. Direct implication: add uncertainty-weighting layer on top of speaker weights.

papers.title: Evaluating Financial Sentiment with Annotators Instruction Assisted Prompting
papers.summary: Instruction-assisted LLM prompting for financial earnings sentiment. GPT-based approach achieves 82% accuracy, outperforming ChatGPT 4o (77.6%) and Gemini (68%). Tests on earnings transcript data with return prediction.
papers.relevance_reason: H171 (new hypothesis): LLM API (GPT-4o-mini) as drop-in replacement for local FinBERT in H168. $OPENAI_API_KEY present. Cost: GPT-4o-mini at $0.15/1M tokens x ~4M tokens for H168 universe ≈ $0.60 total. No local GPU needed, faster iteration, comparable accuracy.

papers.title: Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Analyzing Earnings Call Transcripts: Methodologies and Applications
papers.authors: Umair Zakir, Evan Daykin, Amssatou Diagne, Jacob Faile
papers.summary: Comparative analysis of BERT, FinBERT, and ULMFiT on earnings call transcripts. Tests preprocessing, computational efficiency, optimization. Finds FinBERT most effective for financial domain with good signal extraction.
papers.relevance_reason: H168 validation: confirms FinBERT is best baseline for earnings transcript scoring. Validates H168 model choice. No staging needed — confirms existing H168 design.

papers.title: RegimeFolio: A Regime Aware ML System for Sectoral Portfolio Optimization in Dynamic Markets
papers.summary: Integrates VIX-based regime classifier with sector-specific ensemble learners (RF/GBM) and dynamic mean-variance optimizer. Tested 2020-2024 on 34 large-cap US equities: 137% cumulative return, Sharpe 1.17, 12% lower max drawdown vs benchmarks.
papers.relevance_reason: H165 step 2 implementation guide: regime detection + sector ML directly replicable for 30-50 stock universe. Soft-regime VIX classifier outperforms binary thresholds. Practical framework applicable to production portfolio.

papers.title: Janus-Q: End-to-End Event-Driven Trading via Hierarchical-Gated Reward Modeling
papers.summary: Event-centric trading RL framework on 62.4k annotated financial news with fine-grained event types and CAR labels. Hierarchical Gated Reward Model: 102% Sharpe improvement, 17.5% direction accuracy gain vs baselines.
papers.relevance_reason: H168 long-term direction: RL on earnings event signals with CAR labels. Complex to implement but confirms event-driven NLP signal quality. Validates H168 hypothesis direction.

papers.title: Generating Alpha: Hybrid AI Trading System Integrating TA, ML and Financial Sentiment for Regime-Adaptive Equity Strategies
papers.authors: Varun Narayan Kannan Pillai, Akshay Ajith, Sumesh K J
papers.summary: Hybrid system: EMA/MACD, RSI/Bollinger, FinBERT sentiment, XGBoost, VIX regime filters. 24-month backtest: 135.49% return, outperforms S&P 500/NASDAQ-100 with lower drawdown. Validates sentiment + regime gate combination.
papers.relevance_reason: H165/H168 combined approach blueprint. Published Jan 2026. Demonstrates 24-month profitable backtest integrating FinBERT + macro regime gating — close to our target architecture.

papers.title: Reasoning or Overthinking: LLMs on Financial Sentiment Analysis
papers.summary: Zero-shot LLM evaluation on financial sentiment. Counterintuitive finding: GPT-4o WITHOUT Chain-of-Thought reasoning performs better than reasoning-based prompting. Identifies architectural bias in LLMs vs human financial interpretation.
papers.relevance_reason: H171 implementation note: use simple prompts for GPT-4o-mini earnings sentiment, not multi-step reasoning. Chain-of-Thought adds noise for financial classification tasks.

papers.title: Modeling Regime Structure via the Financial Chaos Index
papers.summary: Tensor/eigenvalue-based Financial Chaos Index captures realized volatility via asset co-fluctuations. Regime-switching framework identifies 3 distinct regimes (low/intermediate/high-chaos) with differing persistence.
papers.relevance_reason: H165 alternative regime indicator to VIX threshold. Structural market co-fluctuation regime may capture different information than VIX alone.

papers.title: Improving S&P 500 Volatility Forecasting through Regime-Switching Methods
papers.summary: Multi-regime SPX volatility forecasting using soft Markov switching + spectral clustering + XGBoost. Tested 11 years (2014-2025). Soft-regime probabilities allow continuous exposure adjustment.
papers.relevance_reason: H165 implementation: soft-regime probabilities are more nuanced than binary VIX>25 gate. XGBoost classifier practical for retail implementation.

papers.title: Earnings Sentiment NLP pipeline: FinBERT + Loughran-McDonald
papers.summary: Python pipeline combining LM dictionary and FinBERT for earnings transcript scoring. Tests correlation with short-term returns. Signal persists to ~day 3-5, then decays — consistent with HFT arbitrage.
papers.relevance_reason: H168 implementation reference. Signal decay by day 5 confirms H168's 20-day hold is too long for NLP-only signal — should combine with price gap confirmation for sustained drift.

papers.title: QuantConnect LEAN: ThetaData Integration
papers.summary: ThetaData integration for QuantConnect LEAN backtesting. Free tier: EOD SPX options data. Standard tier ($25/mo): intraday data. Enables proper H170 0DTE iron condor backtest.
papers.relevance_reason: H170 data blocker solution: ThetaData free tier has EOD options data. Standard tier ($25/mo) provides intraday — minimum requirement for proper 0DTE backtest.

papers.title: Semi-analytical pricing of American options with hybrid dividends
papers.summary: Semi-analytical method for American options pricing with discrete+continuous dividends. Addresses complexity of dividend-induced price drops and optimal exercise timing.
papers.relevance_reason: H162 options pricing: dividend impact on covered call pricing around ex-dates. Useful for H162 real backtest but not actionable without historical options data.
